- **Story:** As Morgan, I want one written decision on named actors in specs: the name (actor), the closed catalogue, the then forms and what each adapter must provide, so that I can read any spec and tell who observes the outcome and what a test double for that actor must record.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the tests with fakes and fixtures, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then docs/decisions/ADR-spec-actors.md names the concept (actor, in the UML and use-case sense: anyone or anything outside the system that interacts with it, Steve's ruling; actor and observer were considered and set aside; the concurrency actor model is a different concept and the ADR says so), the closed catalogue with each actor's test double and adapter obligation (caller, client, store, events as the core candidates; clock and scheduler stay declared effects and spec givens; external service only by an adapter-added Decider), and records the dissent on seven versus four actors
  2. Given the tests with fakes and fixtures, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then it keeps fails with and the D20 succeeds remainder (no return type, no endpoint output, effects none) and records the unranked grammar seed that may later replace returns and responds with actor sentences in one step, with no alias and no second spelling
  3. Given the tests with fakes and fixtures, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then a Decider approves it, informed by the measure card's results (the bootstrap phase: the numbers inform, they do not keep or revert anything)
